Argon AI helps professionals acquire detailed answers to inquiries about clinical trials, existing medicines, the healthcare landscape, and the competitive market in minutes, not months.

about_short_description.short_description: Argon AI: Automating life sciences activities in clinical and commercial settings.

product.name: Secondary Research
product.description: A database search tool for drugs, clinical assets, medical literature, and patents to support life sciences research.

product.name: Asset Landscapes
product.description: Provides accurate and comprehensive lists of approved and clinical assets with AI-driven follow-up question answering.

product.name: Disease Landscapes
product.description: Delivers insights on total addressable market, growth trends, competitive benchmarks, and safety and efficacy data for diseases.

product.name: Patient Journey Mapping
product.description: Analyzes standard of care, diagnostics, and treatment sequencing to map patient journeys in clinical settings.

product.name: Clinical Trial Benchmarking
product.description: Searches and extracts clinical trial information including endpoints and inclusion/exclusion criteria for analysis.

product.name: Competitive Intelligence
product.description: Automates tracking of competitors, assets, clinical trials, and research by analyzing secondary and primary data sources.
